newsitem.title: PERU: Lima shrs end broadly stable.
newsitem.headline: Lima shrs end broadly stable.

text.p: Shares on the Lima stock exchange closed broadly stable Wednesday as players believed gains earlier in the month had brought prices to their ceiling, brokers said.
They added the market would likely close narrowly mixed again Thursday.
Wednesday, the General Index fell 0.14 percent to 1,520.8 points, while the blue-chip Selective Index rose 0.12 percent to 2,178.0 points.
In a total of 1,460 trades, volume was estimated at 25.4 million soles ($9.8 million), brokers said.
The market rose early in the session but fell back towards the end of the day, brokers said.

"The rise was speculative, since most investors consider the prices -- at least of the most important shares -- have reached an appropriate level for their value," said an analyst at a leading local brokerage, who asked not to be named.
Benchmark Telefonica del Peru gained 1.08 percent, closing at 5.61 soles on volume of 1.85 million shares.
Cement company Cementos Lima closed up 1.39 percent at 4.38 soles on volume of 1.7 million shares.
